examples.en: There was leftover kimchi in the fridge, so I made kimchi fried rice.

examples.ko: 김치볶음밥에 계란 프라이를 올려 먹으면 맛있어요.
examples.en: Kimchi fried rice is tasty with a fried egg on top.
For lunch I want to eat kimchi fried rice.

examples.ko: 김치볶음밥은 만들기 쉬워서 자주 해 먹어요.
examples.en: Kimchi fried rice is easy to make, so I cook it often.

examples.ko: 친구가 만든 김치볶음밥 맛이 정말 좋았어요.
examples.en: The kimchi fried rice my friend made tasted really good.

examples.ko: 여기요, 김치볶음밥 하나랑 라면 하나 주세요.
examples.en: Excuse me, one kimchi fried rice and one ramyeon, please.

explain: 김치를 넣고 볶은 밥이에요. 집에서는 '만들다'나 '해 먹다'를 쓰고, 식당에서는 '시키다'나 '주문하다'를 써요. 새우볶음밥, 야채볶음밥처럼 앞에 재료를 붙여 다른 볶음밥도 말할 수 있어요.
explain_en: It is fried rice stir-fried with kimchi. At home people say '만들다' or '해 먹다', and at a restaurant '시키다' or '주문하다'. You can put other ingredients in front, as in 새우볶음밥 or 야채볶음밥, to name other fried rice dishes.
